messages:
sara.leung: heads up — multiple customers pinging support: console usage graphs for several tenants show "Last updated: ~3 hours ago" and hourly rows stopped around 2026-03-16T09:12Z. customers see 0s for the last 3 hourly buckets. any quick checks?

jonathan.voss: looking — initial check on the CDC pipeline shows the usage-consumer group paused and then rebalanced. consumer lag jumped at 09:10 UTC. can anyone grab the broker / consumer logs?

priya.khan: saw an error from the backfill job that kicked off automatically: 
```
ERROR: failed to apply row (tenant_id=acme): column "session_duration_ms" does not exist at line 1
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/backfills/run_backfill.py", line 211, in process_row
    db.insert(row)
  File "/opt/backfills/db.py", line 88, in insert
    raise DBSchemaError(msg)
DBSchemaError: column session_duration_ms missing
```
That started ~09:09 UTC and looks like it caused the backfill to crash and the consumer to back off. schema migration for session_duration landed yesterday but may not have applied to the read replica the backfill uses.

eng-infra-bot: ALERT: kafka-consumer-group usage-consumer | group paused | coordinator reassign | partitions with high-lag: [4,7,12] | time: 2026-03-16T09:11:03Z

kevin.martin: thanks @priya.khan / @jonathan.voss. quick mitigation suggestions: 
- restart the consumer group to clear the paused state: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server b-3.kafka:9092 --group usage-consumer --reset-offsets --to-latest --execute --topic tenant-usage` (use with caution)
- patch backfill to skip missing column checks for this run: `./run-backfill --start 2026-03-16T06:00Z --end 2026-03-16T10:00Z --ignore-schema-diff`
- if we can't risk backfill flags, run ad-hoc SQL to fill hourly aggregates for affected tenants: 
```sql
INSERT INTO hourly_usage (tenant_id, hour, tokens, requests)
SELECT tenant_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) as hour, SUM(tokens), COUNT(*)
FROM raw_requests_replica
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-16T06:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-16T10:00:00Z'
AND tenant_id IN ('acme','oriental-llc')
GROUP BY tenant_id, hour
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, hour) DO UPDATE SET tokens = EXCLUDED.tokens, requests = EXCLUDED.requests;
```

jonathan.voss: checked replica schema — indeed the replica missed the migration `20260315_add_session_duration.sql`. that explains the DBSchemaError. it was applied on primary but the replica restore last week didn't run migrations.

priya.khan: OK. plan: 1) apply migration to replica ASAP (low-risk ALTER ADD COLUMN with null default) 2) re-run backfill with `--resume` 3) monitor consumer lag and console until hourly rows return. I'll own the migration and backfill.

kevin.martin: i'll coordinate a controlled consumer restart if lag doesn't drop within 15m of backfill resume. also opening an incident ticket and notifying impacted customers with ETA ~2 hours. cc: @sara.leung for customer comms. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara.leung: thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer note and post to the affected tenants channel. please post the backfill run command and success/failure logs here once done.

priya.khan: migration applied to replica at 09:42 UTC (`ALTER TABLE raw_requests_replica ADD COLUMN session_duration_ms bigint;`). re-running backfill now with `./run-backfill --start 2026-03-16T06:00Z --end 2026-03-16T10:00Z --resume`. will update in-thread.

eng-infra-bot: INFO: backfill-job-1223 started by priya.khan at 2026-03-16T09:43:21Z

jonathan.voss: monitoring kafka: consumer lag for partitions [4,7,12] dropping from 120k -> 3k after backfill progress. console hourly rows starting to appear for a couple tenants.

priya.khan: backfill finished at 10:05 UTC. sanity check: hourly counts for acme and oriental-llc restored for 06:00-09:00 buckets. leaving a task to run the hourly job once to catch any stragglers.

kevin.martin: created INC-2026-0451 for tracking root cause (replica migrations not applied during last restore) and next steps (automation to run migrations on replicas). assigned to eng-infra.

sara.leung: customer update sent: apologized + noted ETA ~2h, now updated to "resolved" and provided workaround note (console reflects accurate numbers now but may take up to 30m to fully propagate). :white_check_mark:

jonathan.voss: follow-up action items: 
- add pre-check to backfill job to verify replica schema match (ticketed)
- add alert that flags backfill job failures due to DBSchemaError
- automation to apply migrations to replicas post-restore

priya.khan: agreed. will file follow-ups in INC-2026-0451 and link PR for pre-check. closing thread once postmortem drafted.

kevin.martin: nice work team. can we also add a short-runbook for support to triage similar console stale cases? saves time next time.

sara.leung: noted — i'll write a 1-pager runbook and post to #support-playbooks. thanks all. :raised_hands:
